CustomField.description: Filter, display and search settings for a lookup shown as a Record Picker. Edited in Form Builder's Record Picker Settings window and stored as JSON in the shape the standard Salesforce record picker takes (filter, displayInfo and matchingInfo). Filter values can merge fields from the form record, such as {{AccountId}}, to narrow suggestions by another answer; a filter whose merged value is blank is skipped. Also applies to forms built from custom metadata.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Filter, display and search settings for a lookup shown as a Record Picker, managed from the Record Picker Settings editor in Form Builder. Filter values can use merge fields from the form record, such as {{AccountId}}, to limit suggestions based on another answer.
CustomField.label: Record Picker Config
